svg.aria-label: Why input-to-state stability is a separate property. Left: dx/dt = −3x + (1 + 2x squared)u is globally exponentially stable for u = 0, but with x(0) = 2 and the bounded input u = 1 the state escapes to infinity at t = ln 1.5 = 0.41. Right: dx/dt = −x cubed + u is ISS: a bounded input gives a bounded state, of size about the cube root of the input
